name: Keynote Inviter
job_description: Introduce the speaker. Keep the time during presentation and Q&A. Optionally serve as another [[Q&A Producer]].

name: Q&A Producer
job_for_who: Somewhat familiar with the topic of the talk.
job_description: Sit on stage, not introduced. Clarify and relay online questions to the Speaker.

name: Q&A Tracker
job_description: Sit on stage, not introduced. Relay online questions to the Speaker.

name: Industry Chair
job_description: During the Industry Panel, join the Zoom Webinar remotely as a panelist. Pick the most interesting online questions and read them to the panel.

name: Unconference Chair
job_description: Run the Unconference opening plenary: run the topic votes and announce each topic with its room and host. Also host one of the groups as an [[Unconference Room Host]]. At the reconvene, invite each group's presenter to share conclusions, then close the session for everyone, on-site and online.

name: Unconference Room Host
job_description: Host one Unconference group, either on-site or in a Zoom breakout room. Facilitate the discussion, and have the group pick a presenter to share its conclusions at the reconvene.

name: Mic Runner
job_description: Distribute a mic to questions in the audience. Sit down outside Q&A, but keep standing during Q&A. Tip: don't take the mic back immediately after the question. Allow multi-round exchange.

name: Webinar Sentinel On-Site
job_for_who: Best with sensitive hearing: must distinguish headphone audio from room audio.
job_description: Sit on-site in the backstage but view only the Zoom Webinar on the provided laptop. Not only listen, but try to understand and enjoy the content --- you catch more issues this way. Keep the auditorium screen visible so any mismatch is caught, but pay main attention to the webinar. Use the provided laptop and headphones. If a panelist account is making noises, mute it.

name: Webinar Sentinel Online
job_description: View the Zoom Webinar remotely and report any issue on Slack.

name: Zoom Master
job_for_who: High commitment. Has to miss parts of the conference.
job_description: Configure Zoom Meetings / Webinars under time constraints. Follow the Virtual Chair around on the first day to observe jobs. Use [#panelist-names](https://ismir2026.slack.com/archives/C0CER5XPX19) to identify users to promote to panelists.

name: Poster Session Helpdesk On-site
job_description: Assist with technical issues at the Poster Session on-site.

name: Poster Session Helpdesk Online
job_description: Assist with technical issues at the Poster Session online.

name: Venue AV/IT
job_description: Wizards of the room system.

name: On-site Session Chair
guides: On-site Session Chair: Instructions and Guidelines
job_description: Assigned to one paper session. Attends the paper session onsite. Introduce every talk during the Oral Session. Check name pronunciations beforehand. Keeps time during presentations. Before the conference, get to know the 10 presenters. Confirm the session's presentation schedule and modality with them. Arrange timing and seating within the Oral Session.

name: Online Session Chair
guides: Online Session Chair: Instructions and Guidelines
job_description: Assigned to one paper session. Attends the paper session online and engages with the online participants on Slack during the session. Before the conference, get to know the 10 presenters on Slack.

name: Award Session Chair
job_description: Host one Award Nominee Oral Session. Introduce every talk during the Award Nominee Oral Session. Check name pronunciations beforehand. Keeps time during presentations. Before the conference, get to know the presenters. Confirm the session's presentaion schedule and modality with them. Arrange timing and seating within the Award Nominee Oral Session.

name: Prep Room Assistant
job_for_who: Familiar with Zoom. Has to miss the Award Nominee Oral Session, so better be a different volunteer for each session.
job_description: Host one Award Nominee Oral Session. Introduce every talk during the Award Nominee Oral Session. Check name pronunciations beforehand. Keeps time during presentations. Before the conference, get to know the presenters. Confirm the session's presentaion schedule and modality with them. Arrange timing and seating within the Award Nominee Oral Session.

name: Special Session Assistant
job_for_who: Best familiar with Zoom. Interested in the Special Session.
job_description: The on-site host of the session. Sit on stage, introduced. Relay online and local questions to the panelists. Keeps time.

name: Tutorial Moderator
job_description: Serve as the in-room anchor for tutorial sessions on behalf of the remote tutorial chairs by introducing the tutorial and presenters, keeping the session on schedule, and coordinating with the room. Training will be provided separately by the tutorial chairs.

name: Zoom Support
job_description: Helps with Zoom-related issues.

name: LBD Support
job_description: Transform the Poster Hall into the LBD setup.
